versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- No file or content updates were made in version 1.0.1.

- Initial release of the skill for helping early-stage entrepreneurs win their first 100 customers, based on "The Minimalist Entrepreneur" principles.
- Introduces the "concentric circle" sales method: start with friends/family, expand to communities, then reach out to strangers.
- Provides actionable steps, cold outreach templates, and early pricing advice.
- Focuses on one-to-one manual sales rather than product launches.
- Offers a checklist: lists to contact, cold email template, initial pricing, weekly goals, and tracking methods.
